units.function: Precondition service used by Issue, Routine, Pipeline and offboarding workflows to reject assignment to missing/cross-Company/pending/terminated/unknown-state Agents or Agents whose Agent-only reporting chain is invalid.
units.dependencyDirection: The application helper queries the Agent table, delegates graph semantics to the shared eligibility package and throws HTTP-layer errors with structured details. Work/Routine/Pipeline services call it immediately before their own mutations, so it is a distributed guard rather than a single assignment authority.
units.keyDataModels: Agent opaque ID, Company, lifecycle status and reportsTo; assignment kind work/routine; structured agent_not_assignable conflict with reason, invalid/missing ancestor and serialized ancestor chain.
units.lifecycle: For a non-null assignee it loads the target by global ID, verifies Company equality, loads the full Company Agent set, computes eligibility and either returns or throws a typed conflict. Paused Agents can remain assignable while direct invocation is blocked, separating planning from execution.
units.testAssessment: No dedicated service unit was found; behavior is exercised indirectly across callers and the already-audited shared/invokability tests. The guard provides useful structured details but performs an unbounded full-Company Agent read on every check and is a time-of-check/time-of-use decision: status/reporting edges can change before the caller commits assignment. Cross-Company target is handled, yet declared ancestor_cross_company and ancestor_depth_exceeded reasons are never produced by assignmentReasonFromHealth; unmatched health states collapse to ancestor_missing. Tests do not prove every caller invokes the guard, transactional snapshot consistency, reason-code exhaustiveness, large organizations, membership/permission/capability constraints or concurrent termination.
units.designRationale: Centralize lifecycle and reporting-chain validation across heterogeneous Work assignment entry points while allowing paused Agents to retain queued work and providing repairable structured failure details.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs an authoritative AssignmentEligibility decision distinct from ExecutionAdmission, with responsibility, capability, policy, data and risk context captured at a versioned snapshot.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the planning-versus-execution split, null-assignee behavior, structured reason code and pure graph-health dependency. Move the check into one application command/transaction or optimistic version fence; require Company membership, AgentRole, accountable-human ResponsibilityContract, Connector capabilities, autonomy/risk policy and data authorization. Emit an eligibility decision receipt and use exhaustive stable codes rather than HTTP errors in the service.
units.responsibilityConflict: A structurally healthy Agent-only chain is treated as sufficient for assignment even if no human accepted responsibility. The guard does not bind goal, delegator, accountable human, exact Agent role, permissions/data contract, capability or evidence, and its stale snapshot can authorize assignment after the organization or lifecycle changed.

units.function: Pure and database-backed execution-admission projection for Agent lifecycle/reporting-chain health, plus descendant invalidation and a policy helper deciding when existing Runs should be cancelled.
units.dependencyDirection: The pure evaluator delegates to shared eligibility semantics; the DB wrapper loads all Company Agents. Heartbeat, watchdog, attention, recovery, thread interaction and Agent termination flows consume the result, so one projection influences both new invocation and cancellation/recovery behavior.
units.keyDataModels: Agent organization row; invokable boolean; block reason and English message/details; invalidOrgChain flag; direct non-invokable status set; affected descendant IDs.
units.lifecycle: Missing, paused, terminated, pending or unknown-state Agents are blocked directly; invalid Agent-manager chains are blocked with chain details. Descendant traversal marks non-terminated reports affected by a terminated manager. Cancellation is recommended only for direct termination or an invalid organization chain, not for pause/pending/unknown status.
units.testAssessment: The previously audited 69-line pure suite covers terminated ancestry, missing managers, cycles and descendant traversal. Missing are direct status cases, unknown status, cross-Company manager, depth overflow, stale DB-wrapper input, exhaustive reason mapping, cancellation policy, deep/wide graph bounds and races. The declared manager_company_mismatch and reporting_chain_too_deep reason values are unreachable because invalidChainReason collapses every non-terminated/non-cycle health result to manager_missing. evaluateAgentInvokabilityFromDb accepts a caller-supplied Agent snapshot while separately loading Company peers, so a stale target status can be evaluated against fresh peers. Full Company scans occur repeatedly in hot heartbeat/watchdog paths.
units.designRationale: Make run admission and organizational invalidation deterministic and shareable across runtime workflows, while keeping pause durable without necessarily cancelling already running work and cancelling when termination or broken supervision makes execution unsafe.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs version-fenced ExecutionAdmission and ongoing RunLease validation that considers accountable human, approval, exact action digest, Connector attestation, capabilities, authorization/data policy and organization state—not only Agent lifecycle.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the pure evaluator/result union, separate assignable/invokable semantics, affected-descendant calculation and explicit cancellation policy. Generalize to a typed Human/Agent responsibility graph terminating at an active accountable human; evaluate a single versioned snapshot, use exhaustive machine codes, cache/incrementally project graph health, and bind admission to Work/contract/action/permissions/data/approval/runtime attestation. Revalidate through a fenced Run lease and emit evidence when eligibility changes.
units.responsibilityConflict: An Agent-only reportsTo chain never proves human accountability or accepted delegation. Cancellation criteria omit approval withdrawal, responsibility transfer, permission/data-contract revocation, Connector health/attestation expiry and high-risk policy changes. A stale caller-supplied target row can disagree with current lifecycle state, while English messages and non-exhaustive reason mapping weaken audit interpretation.
